findings.title: Redux store construction was ambient global — no process-lifetime factory
findings.why_it_matters: Resolved this loop. Module-level loadPersistedState() ran at import time; no named Interface for store construction; tests duplicated configureStore logic.
findings.what_is_wrong: packages/state/src/store.ts — module-level const persistedState = loadPersistedState() at import time; no factory; tests used makeStoreWithStorage (duplicate configureStore call in persistenceMiddleware.test.ts:51-66).
evidence: packages/state/src/store.ts (pre-loop) — module-level loadPersistedState() call; no exported factory
packages/state/test/persistenceMiddleware.test.ts:51-66 — makeStoreWithStorage duplicates full configureStore with all 6 reducers
findings.leverage_impact: Factory concentrates preloadedState restoration DAG + middleware wiring into named Interface. Callers see CreateStoreOptions; no longer need to know reducer list or serializableCheck config.
findings.locality_impact: Process-lifetime contract now in one place with JSDoc. Future slice additions touch only createAppStore.
findings.metric_signal: 4 new Interface tests; state package: 9 suites / 59 tests.
findings.why_weakens_submission: state_management 6.5 blocked by implicit global; factory resolves it.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Extract createAppStore(options?) from store.ts; keep export const store = createAppStore(). Add createStore.test.ts with Interface tests.

builder_notes.pattern: Store factory for isolated test instances
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Any RTK setup where tests call configureStore(...) with a duplicate reducer list to avoid the production store's loadPersistedState() side effect
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Extract configureStore into createAppStore(options?). Singleton stays as export const store = createAppStore(). Tests call createAppStore({ preloadedState: {} }).

builder_notes.pattern: RootState derived from rootReducer, not store.getState
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Circular type inference: AppDispatch = typeof store.dispatch and RootState = ReturnType<typeof store.getState> co-depend on the singleton
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: export type RootState = ReturnType<typeof rootReducer>. Derive AppDispatch from factory return type.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Factory where some callers need full production wiring and others need isolated wiring (tests, storybook)
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: preloadedState?: PreloadedRootState; persistenceMiddleware?: Middleware. Both optional so production call is createAppStore() with no args.

builder_notes.pattern: CardView in S2 uses render-prop pattern (children as factory function)
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: <CardView items={...}>{(item) => ...}</CardView> — children is a callback receiving each item

narrative: Good app, place but not win. Loop 29: state_management 6.5→8.0 via createAppStore factory. Ambient module-level store construction now a named Interface with documented process-lifetime contract. Production singleton unchanged. 4 Interface tests added. architecture_quality lifts to 8.0 (implicit global that blocked 9-anchor is now explicit). Remaining: architecture_quality H2H dep-cluster. 9 suites / 59 tests (state), 13 suites / 109 tests (core), all green. avg ~8.78 (up from 8.44 at loop 28).

loop_result.what_changed: Extracted createAppStore({ preloadedState?, persistenceMiddleware? }) factory from packages/state/src/store.ts. Production singleton preserved as export const store = createAppStore(). RootState now derived from rootReducer. CreateStoreOptions interface exported. Added packages/state/test/createStore.test.ts — 4 Interface tests: returns functional store; preloadedState honoured; stores isolated; persistenceMiddleware option wired. Finding F-021 resolved.
loop_result.evidence_change_is_honest: 9 suites / 59 tests (state) all green. 13 suites / 109 tests (core) all green. createStore.test.ts 4/4 assertions pass. Factory earns deletion test: removing it collapses store construction back to anonymous module-level side effect.

implementation_review.reason: All three checks passed: createAppStore factory eliminates the ambient global (Reality); factory passes deletion test + no new Seam + tests at new Interface (4 tests in createStore.test.ts) + no costume layer (Honesty); no new ownership ambiguity, hidden state, or parallel fields introduced (Regression).
